editorial:
Ever wondered how far someone would go for a giant pile of money? You get to see that in this wild ride where a wealthy widow decides she is not sharing her inheritance. Instead of playing nice, she hires two hitmen to take out her late husband's secret son. It sounds dark, but the movie plays it more like a chaotic game of cat and mouse. The vibe is a mix of a crime thriller and a dark comedy, making you laugh at the absurdity while you wait to see who actually survives the mess.

What really works here is how the chemistry between the hitmen keeps the energy high, even when the plot gets messy. The twists are surprising and the action keeps things moving fast. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the crazy tone of the story. If you love movies where bad people trick each other, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the hitmen realize they are being played by the widow. In a final twist, the target is not as helpless as he seems, and the greed of the characters leads to a chaotic showdown. The bad guys end up betraying each other over the money. By the end, the people who tried to cheat the system lose everything, and the rightful heir manages to survive the madness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime comedies and unexpected plot twists.
